profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I was raised in VB, VA, USA. I received the bulk of my post-secondary education at Old Dominion University with a degree in Electrical Engineering Technology, getting my start at North Carolina Wesleyan College studying mathematics & psychology. Completed multiple leadership courses, to include interpersonal communication fundamentals while serving active duty military.  

Served 10+ years as a Surface Warfare Officer in the United States Navy. I’m grateful to have been afforded the opportunity to hone my leadership skills, communication and public speaking skills, project management, and probably most importantly, grit. Honor to have served along so many brave & dedicated patriots, from every corner of the earth, all walks of life.

Currently, gaining in-depth experience with full-stack web development using Typescript & NodeJS. Building enterprise level, self-hosted web applications using Docker containerization. I will be seeking DevOps and Systems Engineering training in the near future.

I'm passionate about working with others to create the future where everyone is compelled by the golden rule. When you are given so much, it's one's duty to give back to the community.

Countries I've traveled:
Brazil, France, Spain, Ireland, Italy, Germany, Greece, Bahrain, Israel, Jordan, Djibouti, U.A.E, Oman, Albania.

positions.title: Dynamic Fires Officer (LT)
positions.description: Responsible for developing doctrine informing coordinated employment of weapon systems from multiple platforms ranging thousands of miles of Pacific Fleet battle space. Collaborated with 30+ teams across 13 different time-zones on development of fleet wide programs including Tomahawk Weapon System, Joint Command & Control of weapons employment.

positions.title: Technical Instructor (LT)
positions.description: Instructor duty teaching ~96 students celestial navigation & ship-handling simulator training over the course of a 5-week program. Students left the program prepared with advanced skills in leadership, management, and navigation, seamanship, and ship handling of 10-100 metric ton warships.

positions.title: Combat Information Center Officer (LTJG)
positions.description: Led a division of 24 personnel operating radar, sonar, electronic countermeasures, communication, and plotting equipment. Provides information to control stations regarding navigation, movement of friendly and enemy ships and aircraft, and current combat information. Directs the care, operation and maintenance of equipment.

courses.name: HTML, CSS, React, Node, SQL, Express
